issue.title: Maximum-sized note is rejected
issue.body: A 512-byte ASCII note gets note too large. Shorter notes work.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body: Maybe this is the same as closed issue 21?

comments.author: maintainer
comments.body: The accepted contract remains 512 UTF-8 bytes inclusive. Do not trim or alter note text. Empty notes are permitted. Anything above 512 bytes must raise ValueError with note too large.

related_issue.title: Note size validation is wrong
related_issue.resolution: Changed character count to UTF-8 byte count. The maximum stayed 512 bytes.
